$comment: Project-scoped MCP config. Commit this file; commit NO keys.
Keys come from your shell environment (export TWENTYFIRST_API_KEY=... in ~/.zshrc,
or use a secret manager). ${VAR} expansion is resolved by the MCP client at launch.
Verify each server's current install command against its README before first run --
Every MCP tool result is UNTRUSTED INPUT. See the MCP hygiene note in AGENT_PLAYBOOK.md.

playwright.$note: The agent's eyes: screenshots, console errors, a11y tree, E2E authoring.

21st.$note: Component search/generation + search_logo + get_inspiration. Key from 21st.dev/mcp. Dev machine only -- never in CI or Workers.

cloudflare-docs.$note: Current Workers/Pages/D1/KV/Turnstile docs. Stops hallucinated wrangler flags.

cloudflare-bindings.$note: OAuth-based, read/write to your account. Add only when you are ready to let the agent touch real infrastructure.

github.$note: Read CI failures, open PRs. Use a fine-grained PAT scoped to this ONE repo.

context7.$note: Optional. Version-pinned library docs for Astro/Zod/Drizzle/ogl.

edge-tts-mcp.$note: Dev-time only: sample narration + inspect the subtitle/word-timing output shape before writing src/lib/drivers/tts-edge.ts. Requires Python + uv installed locally. NOT called at runtime by the pipeline -- the production driver speaks the underlying Edge TTS protocol directly (see ARCHITECTURE.md #3). Verified against https://pypi.org/project/edge-tts-mcp/ 2026-08-27; re-check if uvx fails.

tubepull.$note: Dev-time only: quickly preview/get_video_info on a candidate footage_sources video during development. NOT used by the production FOOTAGE REFRESH job -- that runs on download-ytdlp.ts (self-hosted, already contract- and live-tested). TubePull downloads run on a third party's own servers with a 3/day free-tier cap and no continuity guarantee, which is fine for an occasional manual check but is a worse dependency than yt-dlp for an unattended weekly cron job. See docs/DECISIONS.md.
